reason: Node's documented way to set the exit status. It lets buffered stderr/stdout drain, which process.exit would cut short, and bun lint's n/no-process-exit forbids process.exit. The fake Pi child must flush its socket and stdout before it exits, as real Pi does.

process.kill throws ESRCH when the fake tmux session already exited. That is the expected end state of a hang-up, so the catch swallows it; logging would flood test output and rethrowing would fail cleanup for sessions that finished on their own.
